what: Mistake: while the focus was 'make Athena faster first', median time per landed job rose from 25 to about 60 minutes (29 Oct to 4 Nov) and I did not notice. I queued quality steps (planning for more jobs, proof runs) without weighing their time, and the throughput review's own speed design request sat queued for 6 days.
why: I tracked GitHub test-run time as the speed measure instead of whole-job time
